title: FOMC minutes (April 27-28 2027 meeting), 2:00 p.m. ET — an opex-week Wednesday that misses VIX settlement by one day
source: EST: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, re-fetched direct 2026-09-08 by this lane (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes, footer "Last Update: August 19, 2026") and re-parsed rather than inherited from the proposal. The page states the convention verbatim -- "The minutes of regularly scheduled meetings are released three weeks after the date of the policy decision" -- and its 2027 panel reads verbatim "January 26-27 | March 16-17* | April 27-28 | June 8-9* | July 27-28 | September 14-15* | October 26-27 | December 7-8*". Decision day 2027-04-28 is a Wednesday (verified, not assumed) and +21 days is Wednesday 2027-05-19. THE RULE IS RE-MEASURED BY THIS SESSION, NOT INHERITED: all fourteen fomchistorical<year>.htm pages 2007-2020 were fetched (all HTTP 200) and parsed alongside the live panel, giving 160 distinct minutes release dates 2007-02-21 through 2026-08-19, every one a trading session and 141 of them at exactly D+21. THE SPRING CLASS NEVER DISPLACES: all 11 April-meeting minutes in that record released at exactly D+21, and all 20 May-released minutes landed on a Wednesday, because the only displacement mechanism the record shows is Thanksgiving adjacency and May has no Wednesday-adjacent market holiday (Memorial Day is always a Monday). 2021-04-28 -> 2021-05-19 is an exact date-for-date precedent for this configuration. STATUS STAYS ESTIMATE and not for want of a fetch: the 2027 rows Minutes cells on that page are EMPTY -- no release is posted yet -- and the same page states "Each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it", so the promotion trigger is the 2027-03-16/17 meeting ratifying the April date. federalreserve.gov/newsevents/2027-may.htm, the month page that would carry the 2:00 p.m. release time, returned 404 to this session and is recorded in the ledger probe-ref blocked array. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: CANONICAL FILE written by the fomc-minutes-2027-05-19 initial-research lane (2026-09-08) after reading the one prior proposal, proposals/fomc-minutes-2027-05-19.from-fhfa-hpi-2027-05-25.json, which is now inert. THE PROPOSAL ASKED THE RIGHT SLOT AND THE WRONG QUESTION, on two counts, both corrected in the ledger. (1) ITS CORRIDOR CLAIM IS FALSE. It framed these minutes as "the ONLY scheduled Fed communication" in the 21-day window between the April 28 decision and the 2027-05-29 blackout, landing "at its tail, ten days before the window shuts". The Beige Book publishes at exactly D-14 from each decision day -- 8 of 8 on the Board own 2026 schedule (Jan 14, Mar 4, Apr 15, Jun 3, Jul 15, Sep 2, Oct 14, Nov 25 against meetings ending Jan 28, Mar 18, Apr 29, Jun 17, Jul 29, Sep 16, Oct 28, Dec 9) -- so the June 8-9 2027 edition publishes Wednesday 2027-05-26, inside the corridor and three days before the blackout. These minutes are the FIRST of two scheduled Fed communications in the window, not the only one, and they sit in its middle, not at its tail. Proposed as proposals/beige-book-2027-05-26.from-fomc-minutes-2027-05-19.json (estimate; the Board has posted no 2027 Beige Book schedule and newsevents/2027-may.htm 404s). (2) THE VOL FINDING THE FAMILY CARRIES IS A CALENDAR-POSITION ARTEFACT, and the sibling fomc-minutes-2027-11-17 split it on the wrong variable. That ledger found the 64.4% VIX-down share on minutes days is 71% off-VIX-settlement and 50% on-settlement, and read settlement as the mechanism. Re-measured here on the same 160 releases against MATCHED unconditional bases rather than against each other: the whole effect lives in plain Wednesdays that are neither an opex-week Wednesday nor a settlement day (74.7% down, n=75, vs a 58.3% matched base, p=0.0061), and it is absent on opex-week Wednesdays (50.0%, n=36, vs a 51.1% matched base, p=0.91) and on settlement days (46.8%, n=47, vs 53.2%, p=0.42). Settlement was a proxy: 30 of its 47 on-settlement minutes days ARE opex-week Wednesdays, and inside opex week the settlement flag moves nothing (50.0% on vs 50.0% off). 2027-05-19 IS AN OPEX-WEEK WEDNESDAY (May 2027 third Friday is 05-21) AND IS OFF-SETTLEMENT, because Juneteenth 2027-06-18 is a Cboe holiday and the Cboe rule holiday clause pushes VX May settlement back to Tuesday 2027-05-18 -- reproduced independently here and matching the confirmed canonical vix-expiration-2027-05-18.json. That rare cell has 6 precedents in twenty years. The sibling rule predicts a vol drop here; the corrected variable predicts none, and the ledger registers the separation as a forward test rather than asserting it. Estimate widens caution only and licenses nothing; symbols is empty and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates-keyed.
